cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 58% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.72%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -0.83%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +21.18%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +21.18%, ENPH +10.28%, BE +9.49%, TLN +7.92%, RUN +7.64%. Laggards: FANG -2.03%, MPLX -1.87%, APA -1.62%, PEG -1.57%.
